notes: The paywall now shows every way to buy the course on one screen, cheapest first, instead of offering one level at a time. A level you already own says so and cannot be bought twice, and the screen says plainly that unlocks are separate payments, so buying the whole course outright costs less than climbing to it a level at a time. Profile's Get Premium is now Premium & unlocks, and it covers both the course and the AI tutor: before this, the only way to buy a level was to walk into a locked lesson. It also no longer claims the whole course is free.
